What We Offer

Comprehensive dental care
for every patient

From your child's first dental visit to advanced restorative procedures, our experienced team provides personalised, gentle care across all areas of dentistry.

Preventive Treatments

Routine check-ups and proactive care to catch issues early and keep your smile healthy long-term.

Oral Medicine, Surgery and Diagnosis

Minor oral surgery, difficult extractions, and diagnosis of complex oral conditions.

Restorative / Conservative Treatments

Tooth-coloured fillings, root canal therapy, crowns, and bridges to restore full function and appearance.

Pediatric / Baby / Milk Teeth Treatments

Kid-friendly dental care with a focus on behaviour management and gentle treatments for young smiles.

Pedodontic / Gum Care Treatments

Comprehensive gum care including diagnosis, treatment planning, and maintenance procedures.

Community Outreaches / Dental Camps / Education

Patient education and preventive outreach programmes promoting proper at-home oral care.

Orthodontic / Teeth Alignment

Reviews, cleanings, and re-adjustments alongside personalised teeth-straightening solutions for any age.

Prosthetic / Teeth Replacement Treatments

Full and partial dentures to replace missing teeth, restore chewing function, and improve overall oral health.

Aesthetic Treatments / Tooth Coloured

Laser teeth whitening, porcelain veneers, and premium tooth-coloured cosmetic work.

About Us

Caring for smiles across Kenya


Pine Dentals Consultants is a trusted dental clinic with branches in Thika and Kitengela, dedicated to providing high-quality dental care for patients of all ages — from the very young to seniors.

Our team of qualified dental professionals combines clinical expertise with a warm, welcoming approach to ensure every visit is as comfortable as possible. We believe healthy teeth are the foundation of overall wellbeing.

Patient-First Care

Your comfort and health guide every decision we make.

Modern Equipment

Up-to-date tools and techniques for better outcomes.

Family Friendly

A welcoming environment for patients of all ages.

Affordable Care

Quality dental treatment accessible to the community.
